blocks: image: Doctor's Son Secures AIR 1 in Re-NEET 2026
Punjab's Aryan Gupta has secured AIR Rank 1 in Re-NEET UG 2026. Aryan, from Punjab, secured All India Rank (AIR) 1 by scoring 715 out of 720 marks in the medical entrance examination.
The Ludhiana-based student has become an inspiration for lakhs of NEET aspirants after revealing the intense preparation and dedication behind his success.
Aryan Gupta Secures AIR 1 with 715 Marks

After the declaration of the Re-NEET UG 2026 results, Aryan Gupta shared that securing AIR 1 feels surreal and almost like a dream. Coming from a family of doctors, he said his parents have been extremely happy with the result.
Aryan revealed that he studied for nearly 16 to 17 hours every day during his preparation. He also admitted that there were times when he sacrificed sleep to stay focused on his goal.
Dr. Gupta further revealed that Aryan's elder brother had secured AIR 54 in NEET last year, and Aryan was inspired by his brother's achievement to aim even higher.

However, Aryan Gupta's remarkable journey from Ludhiana to becoming a Re-NEET UG 2026 topper highlights the importance of discipline, consistency, and having a clear purpose in life. His story is expected to inspire countless medical aspirants across the country.
Who is Aryan Gupta in Re-NEET UG 2026?
Aryan Gupta is a student from Ludhiana, Punjab, who jointly secured AIR 1 in Re-NEET UG 2026 along with Panshul Bansal of Haryana by scoring 715 out of 720 marks.
How many hours did Aryan Gupta study for NEET preparation?
Aryan Gupta revealed that he studied for nearly 16 to 17 hours daily and occasionally sacrificed sleep to maintain his preparation schedule.
What is Aryan Gupta's dream career?
Aryan Gupta aims to become an oncologist and work in cancer treatment. His dream was inspired by the loss of his grandmother to cancer when he was in Class 3.
